title: Azure Local Sizer (ODIN)
summary: Size the selected VMs onto Azure Local nodes, and open the same workloads pre-loaded in ODIN for Azure Local.
author: RVTools Analyzer examples

parameters.label: ODIN workload layout
parameters.help: Grouped keeps the ODIN link short. Per-VM falls back to grouped automatically if the link would be too long.

parameters.label: Right-size from observed usage
parameters.help: Uses CPU and consumed memory from the export plus the buffer. RVTools is a point-in-time snapshot — validate with performance history.

parameters.label: Future growth
parameters.help: Matches ODIN's future-growth choices. The selected annual buffer is applied once to the workload.

parameters.label: Node-count sizing
parameters.help: Auto follows ODIN's recommendation: scale CPU, memory and storage for the workload, then add nodes until utilization is below 90%. Choose Fixed to evaluate a specific node count.

parameters.label: Node count (fixed mode)
parameters.help: Used only when Node-count sizing is set to Fixed. Auto starts from ODIN's capacity recommendation and adds nodes until CPU, memory and storage utilization are below 90%.

parameters.label: Volume resiliency
parameters.help: Three-way mirror needs 3 or more nodes. Two-node rows are always evaluated with a two-way mirror.

parameters.label: CPU generation
options: Intel® 6th Gen Xeon® (Granite Rapids / Sierra Forest)
parameters.help: Same CPU generations, per-generation core options, and default core count as ODIN. The sizer scales from ODIN's default core count and uses two sockets per node.

parameters.label: vCPU : physical core ratio
parameters.help: Matches ODIN's supported vCPU overcommit ratios.

parameters.label: Processors per node (Fixed mode)
parameters.help: Used only when Node-count sizing is Fixed.

parameters.label: Cores per socket (Fixed mode)
parameters.help: Used only when Node-count sizing is Fixed. ODIN offers different core counts by CPU generation; an unsupported choice is adjusted to the nearest supported count and reported in Results.

parameters.label: Memory per node (Fixed mode)
parameters.help: Used only when Node-count sizing is Fixed.

parameters.label: Capacity disks per node (fixed mode)
parameters.help: Used when automatic disk sizing is off. ODIN supports up to 40 all-flash capacity disks per node.

parameters.label: Automatically size capacity disks
parameters.help: ODIN automatically increases capacity disk count and, if needed, disk size to meet storage and headroom targets.

parameters.label: Maximum capacity disks per node
parameters.help: ODIN's all-flash maximum is 40 drives; lower this to match the server chassis.

parameters.label: Capacity disk size (TB)
parameters.help: Matches ODIN's supported all-flash capacity-disk sizes in TB. Auto sizing may step up from the selected size.
